title: Understand status families
summary: The first status-code digit groups the result. 2xx means success; 4xx indicates a client-side request issue; 5xx indicates a server-side failure.
introduction: The first status-code digit groups the result. 2xx means success; 4xx indicates a client-side request issue; 5xx indicates a server-side failure. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The first status-code digit groups the result. 2xx means success; 4xx indicates a client-side request issue; 5xx indicates a server-side failure.

blocks.code:
200 OK: successful read
404 Not Found: requested item missing
500 Internal Server Error: server failed
blocks.title: Understand status families

blocks.text: The code gives a broad result. Read the documented error body for more detail.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Classify 201 and 403 by their first digit.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume every non-200 response is a server crash.
For more detail later, use this [Postman further reading](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/overview/).

seo.title: Postman: Understand status families
seo.description: Learn about understand status families in Postman. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
